questions.question:
Consider the following pairs of** Golden Globe Awards 2026** (Film category winners) and their respective titles:

1. Best Drama Film: Hamnet

2. Best Non-English Film: K-Pop Demon Hunters

3. Best Animated Film: The Secret Agent

How many of the above pairs is/are ***correctly ***matched?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1 (One only)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pair 1 is correctly matched** as *Hamnet* won the Best Drama Film at the Golden Globe Awards 2026.
 
• **Pair 2 is not correctly matched** as *The Secret Agent* won the Best Non-English Film Award.
 
• Pair 3 is **not correctly matched** because Best Animated Film went to *K-Pop Demon Hunters*.
 
• Hence, only **one **pair is **correctly matched**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Best Drama Film – Hamnet
 
 
• A Shakespearean drama directed by Chloé Zhao.
 
• Won the Golden Globe for Best Motion Picture – Drama in 2026.
 
• Noted for its literary adaptation and emotional depth.
 
 
 
• Best Comedy/Musical Film – One Battle After Another
 
 
• Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
 
• Starred Leonardo DiCaprio and Teyana Taylor.
 
• Swept five major Golden Globe awards including Best Film (Comedy/Musical).
 
 
 
• Best Animated Film – K-Pop Demon Hunters
 
 
• A Netflix animated feature released in 2025.
 
• Won Best Animated Film at the 83rd Golden Globe Awards.
 
• Also received the Best Original Song award for “Golden”.

questions.question: Who received the Bhavya Bharat Bhushan Award in 2026 for her contributions to sports?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Saina Nehwal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On February 15, 2026, Sadhguru and Isha Outreach presented the inaugural Bhavya Bharat Bhushan awards to honor individuals who have made extraordinary contributions to India's growth and identity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Sports Category:** **Saina Nehwal** was recognized for her grit and determination, which established India as a powerhouse in world badminton and inspired millions of young athletes.
 
• **Other Awardees:**
 
 
• **Science & Technology:** Dr. Nambi Narayanan (Vikas engine pioneer) and AS Kiran Kumar (Former ISRO Chief).
 
• **Arts & Culture:** Dr. N. Rajam (Violinist) and Shrimati Alarmel Valli (Bharatanatyam).
 
• **Literature:** Dr. Vikram Sampath (Acclaimed historian).
 
 
 
• **National Security:** A special honor was bestowed upon the Armed Forces for their coordination during **Operation Sindoor** (following the Pahalgam attack).
 
• **Objective:** The **'Bhavya Bharat Bhushan'** initiative aims to shift the national narrative from individual success to national contribution, celebrating icons whose work serves as a blueprint for a "Grand India."
 
• **Event:** The awards were launched by Sadhguru in the presence of Union Defence Minister **Rajnath Singh** at the Isha Yoga Center in Coimbatore.

questions.question:
With reference to the 6th 'Machhli & Vanya Prani Mitra Awards', identify the correct statements from the following:

1. The awards are jointly organized by the Prabha Khaitan Foundation and WWF-India.

2. The Machhli Award carries a total prize money of ₹2.5 Lakh shared among winners.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both 1 and 2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 6th edition of the Machhli & Vanya Prani Mitra Awards was held on March 23, 2026, in Jaipur to honor wildlife conservationists.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct: The initiative is a collaborative effort between the Prabha Khaitan Foundation (PKF) and WWF-India to recognize "unsung heroes" of the forest.**
 
• Statement 2 is correct: The Machhli Award category has an allocated prize pool of ₹2.5 Lakh, which was equally shared among 4 winners in this edition.
 
• The Vanya Prani Mitra Award has a prize pool of ₹1.5 Lakh shared among 3 winners, focusing on conflict management and habitat protection.
 
• The total prize pool allocated for conservationists in Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh by the foundation is approximately ₹10 lakh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Machhli (The Tigress)__

 __
 
• Known as - The Queen of Ranthambore (T-16)
 
• Legacy - One of the most photographed tigers in the world; the award is named in her honor to celebrate tiger conservation.
 
 
 
• WWF-India__
 
 
• Established - 1969
 
• HQ - New Delhi
 
• Role - Leading conservation organization focused on biodiversity and footprint reduction.
 
 

89:T

questions.question: What is the prize money awarded to the winner of the 2026 Mark Lynton History Prize?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**USD 10,000.**__

__
 
• **Historian William Dalrymple has been awarded the 2026 Mark Lynton History Prize for his book "The Golden Road."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Award Value:** The prize carries an annual award of USD 10,000.
 
• **Criteria:** It is given to a work of history that demonstrates scholarly depth and high-quality written expression.

• **Affiliation:** It is part of the J. Anthony Lukas Book Prize, administered by the Columbia University School of Journalism and the Nieman Foundation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Who was honored with the MP Birla Memorial Award 2025 for pioneering work in Radio Astronomy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Yashwant Gupta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prof. Yashwant Gupta was conferred with the MP Birla Memorial Award 2025 at a ceremony held at the MP Birla Planetarium on 13th March.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Designation:** Prof. Gupta is the Distinguished Professor and Centre Director at the **National Centre for Radio Astrophysics (NCRA-TIFR)**, Pune.
 
• **Core Contribution:** He was recognized for his pioneering research in **Radio Astronomy** and his leadership in national scientific initiatives.
 
• **The Award:** Instituted in 1993, this biennial award honors excellence in **Astronomy, Astrophysics, and Space Sciences**.
 
• **Ceremony Highlights:** The award includes a citation, trophy, cash prize, and a memorial lecture delivered by the recipient.
 
• **Significance:** The MP Birla Planetarium presents this honor to eminent Indian scientists who have made world-class contributions to space science.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• NCRA-TIFR__

 __
 
• The National Centre for Radio Astrophysics is located in Pune and operates the **Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (GMRT)**, one of the world's largest radio telescopes.
 
 
 
• Radio Astronomy__
 
 
• A subfield of astronomy that studies celestial objects at radio frequencies, allowing scientists to observe phenomena invisible to optical telescopes.

questions.question: Who is the recipient of the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in the English language category for the novel titled 'Crimson Spring'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Navtej Sarna.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Sahitya Akademi announced its prestigious annual awards for 2025, honoring 24 authors across various Indian languages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **English Winner:** Former diplomat and author **Navtej Sarna** won for his novel **'Crimson Spring'**.
 
• **Hindi Winner:** **Mamta Kalia** was awarded for her memoir **'Jeete Jee Allahabad'**.
 
• **Award Prize:** The award includes an engraved **copper plaque**, a shawl, and a cash prize of **Rs 1,00,000**.
 
• **Genre Diversity:** The 2025 awards recognized 8 poetry books, 4 novels, 6 short story collections, and other genres including memoirs and essays.
 
• **Ceremony:** The awards will be formally presented on **31 March 2026** in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sahitya Akademi__

 __
 
• India's National Academy of Letters, founded in 1954, it is the highest honor conferred on writers by the Government of India for literary merit.
 
 
 
• Scope__
 __
 
• The Akademi recognizes 24 languages, which include the 22 languages listed in the **Eighth Schedule** of the Constitution, along with **English and Rajasthani**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
